key_claims: Farmed salmon exhibit a production signature resembling mammalian metabolic ageing based on multiomics analysis.
Dietary spermidine supplementation enhances lipid handling in farmed salmon.
limitations: The provided text only contains title and publication information, so specific methodological details and sample sizes are unavailable.
It is unclear whether the findings regarding dietary spermidine apply directly to human ageing or health.
what_not_to_say: Do not claim dietary spermidine reverses human ageing.
Do not report specific numerical dosages, trial durations, or statistical significance not present in the text.
Do not state that salmon and mammalian metabolic ageing are identical in every aspect.
